headline: Take-Two gets hammered on GTA 6 jitters while Labor's tax-cut-for-CGT-reform deal dominates the domestic agenda.

portfolio.summary: TTWO is the big mover — down over 4% on ongoing GTA 6 uncertainty. GOOGL slipped 1.2% despite solid recent earnings. On the ASX side, VGE and VTS both pushed higher, reflecting emerging market and US broad market strength. FUEL.AX and MSFT were essentially flat.

movers.name: Take-Two Interactive
movers.note: GTA 6 angst continues — commentary circulating that the title has become a massive risk for Rockstar. No new release date news, just sentiment drag.

movers.name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
movers.note: Pulled back despite recent earnings strength. Google launched Gemini Omni today — AI product pipeline remains active but market taking a breather.

movers.name: Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF
movers.note: Solid session. AUD/USD lifting slightly helps unhedged positions less, but underlying EM equities were strong.

movers.name: Vanguard US Total Market Shares ETF
movers.note: US broad market gains flowing through. S&P 500 up 0.37% overnight.

movers.name: Vanguard Diversified High Growth ETF
movers.note: Steady lift in line with global equity tailwinds.

movers.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia
movers.note: Minor dip. RBA rate hike bets unwinding — mixed for banks. Still richly valued by most measures.

markets.summary: Broadly positive session. S&P 500 and ASX 200 both edged up, NASDAQ was muted. Gold barely moved. Oil flat at $96.60. AUD/USD ticking higher to 0.717 despite fading RBA rate hike expectations — the bond market is pricing out tightening and that's actually supporting the currency through risk-on flows.

indicators.name: AUD/USD
indicators.note: Rising despite softening RBA hike bets — risk-on tone

indicators.name: Crude Oil (WTI)
indicators.note: Flat; US-Iran deal hopes capping upside

politics.summary: The big domestic story is Labor floating a plan to tie personal income tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing reforms — a politically loaded move that could reshape property investor calculus. Meanwhile, RBA rate hike expectations are unwinding fast, with bond demand surging as inflation fears ease temporarily.

stories.title: Labor to tie tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing changes
stories.why_it_matters: If this gets through, property investors face higher CGT and the end of negative gearing — a significant shift for anyone holding investment property or REIT-adjacent stocks. Watch CBA and the broader banks if sentiment on housing turns.

stories.title: RBA rate rise bets unwind, triggering demand for Australian bonds
stories.why_it_matters: Markets are pricing out RBA hikes, pushing bond yields down and supporting growth assets. Good for your equity holdings in the near term, but watch what the RBA actually says next meeting.

stories.title: Temporary fall in inflation won't ease RBA fears
stories.why_it_matters: Despite the market unwind of hike bets, the RBA still has inflation concerns. Don't assume cuts are coming — the path forward is murky.

ai.summary: Today's AI news is dominated by a single big theme: Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical calling for robust global AI regulation, particularly around autonomous weapons and financial systems. It's a moral framing, not a policy mechanism, but it adds to the global chorus for oversight. The other story worth watching is Google's launch of Gemini Omni.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV urges robust AI regulation in first encyclical
stories.why_it_matters: The Vatican's intervention adds moral weight to the AI regulation debate. No immediate policy impact, but it signals growing consensus that AI governance needs to go well beyond self-regulation — relevant for any AI-exposed holdings like GOOGL and MSFT.

stories.title: Pope warns some weapons now beyond human control
stories.why_it_matters: The autonomous weapons angle is the sharpest part of the encyclical — and the most likely to gain traction with policymakers debating AI in defence contexts.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini Omni
stories.why_it_matters: GOOGL is actively shipping new AI products. Gemini Omni appears to be a multimodal model update — reinforces that Google is not sitting still in the AI race despite the stock's recent dip.

sport.summary: AFL is in mourning after Neale Daniher's death at 65 — a genuinely significant moment for the game. NRL is gearing up for Round 13 with Origin stars' availability unclear. A WSL surf event in NZ was halted after an Australian photographer was bitten by what may have been a shark or sea lion.

stories.title: Neale Daniher, football legend and Fight MND campaigner, dies aged 65
stories.why_it_matters: Daniher coached Melbourne to finals and became one of the most admired figures in Australian sport through his 13-year public battle with MND. A huge loss.

stories.title: NRL Round 13 predicted teams: Mystery surrounds Origin stars; Tigers and Warriors cop major injury blows
stories.why_it_matters: Origin selections are creating lineup chaos heading into Round 13. Tigers and Warriors already hurting — worth watching if you follow either club.

stories.title: World Surf League event in NZ put on hold after Australian photographer bitten by 'shark or a sea lion'
stories.why_it_matters: WSL event halted — unclear if it resumes. Incident highlights the real-world risks at surf competitions in NZ waters.

stories.title: AFL Round 12: Team news, fixtures, games, tips, odds — everything you need to know
stories.why_it_matters: Round 12 wrap and Round 13 preview — all the fixture info in one place.

watch_today.title: TTWO down 4.4% — GTA 6 risk building
watch_today.detail: Take-Two has dropped sharply and the narrative around GTA 6 being 'too big to succeed on schedule' is gaining traction. No earnings catalyst today, but worth deciding if your conviction holds at this price or if the risk/reward has shifted.

watch_today.title: Labor's CGT/negative gearing reform proposal
watch_today.detail: Labor is reportedly linking personal tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing changes. If this progresses, it's a material shift for property investors and could pressure bank stocks including CBA. Early stages — watch for further detail this week.

watch_today.title: Google's Gemini Omni launch — positive for GOOGL thesis
watch_today.detail: Google shipped a new multimodal AI model today. Reinforces the AI product pipeline story even as the stock dipped. No action needed, but good confirmation of the long-term holding case.

watch_today.title: RBA rate hike bets unwinding
watch_today.detail: Bond markets are pricing out RBA hikes. Good near-term tailwind for growth equities and your VDHG/VTS/VGE positions. Watch for any RBA commentary that pushes back on this narrative.
